correctness.rationale: The complete proof establishes closure equations for all six integral edge lengths, yields exactly five atomic summands and all k+1 maximal factorizations, and proves a unique finest common coarsening for every index set via explicit nonnegative capacity allocation. Filip (J. Algebra 687, 2026), Propositions 6.2-6.3 and Corollary 6.4, identifies these with irreducible components and reduced intersections of the homogeneous miniversal toric-pair base. The published edge-polynomial parameter map has finite generic fibers, giving exact Krull dimensions. The extracted checker exhaustively verified all possible common coarsenings through k=3 and all atomic factorizations through k=6. Computations are auxiliary; no unrestricted deformation claim is made.

value.rationale: The degree-six del Pezzo hexagon is a canonical toric polygon and its dilates produce non-isolated Gorenstein 3-fold singularities. The theorem gives unboundedly many pair-deformation branches of distinct dimensions, all simultaneous reduced intersection loci, and an exact k-dimensional common core. This complete incidence arrangement is a natural nontrivial classification rather than a one-example recomputation or an unmotivated numerical cutoff.
